problems: The blind guess (bird or boat) does not match the intended box-kite. The figure should read as a rectangular box with a raised cell on top and a long tail hanging below, and the drawing does not make that clear.

Star 52085 (lower-right corner of the upper cell) is labelled at about (443,254), well to the right of the raised cell, and no gold line reaches it. The cell's lower-right corner should sit near (381,253), where the gold edge from the peak (52009 at 388,181) comes down.

The box is drawn as a gold quadrilateral (55282 at 180,210; 52943 at 326,238; 53740 at 276,281; 55598 at 162,292). It is a loose polygon, and the blue silhouette inside it is a skewed trapezoid that does not follow the box edges, so the box reads as a skewed quadrilateral rather than a box.
The raised cell is a thin blue wedge running from the box corner up to the peak. It is not a clear rectangle on top of the box, so the 'raised upper cell' part is not readable.
The tail is a long, flat gold line from the bow knot (54682 at about 220,375) to the tip (51718 at 398,395), with a blue curve alongside. It reads as a stick, not as ribbons trailing from a knot.
The bridle knot (55705 at 154,269) sits on the left, outside the box, which is correct, but its label collides with the box label and the gold edge passes through it.
Labels overlap the figure and each other ('upper-right corner of the bo' and 'lower-right corner of the box' run across the strokes), and the title is cut off, so the figure is hard to read.
output.advice: Redraw so the kite reads clearly as a box kite. (1) Box body: keep 55282 at about (180,210) upper-left, 52943 at (326,238) upper-right, 53740 at (276,281) lower-right, and 55598 at (162,292) lower-left, and close them as a clean, roughly rectangular outline. Use one closed silhouette instead of a loose trapezoid. (2) Raised cell: place it on top of the box's upper edge, between about x=200 and x=326. Its base corners are 52943 (326,238) on the right and a left base near (200,210), and its top is the peak 52009 at about (388,181), so the cell rises from the frame to the peak. (3) Move 52085 to about (381,253), the lower-right corner of the cell where it meets the box, and draw a gold edge from 52009 down to 52085 and from 52085 back to 52943. Relabel or remove the stray label at (443,254). (4) Bridle: 55705 at (154,269) should attach to the left side of the box with short gold edges to 55282 and 55598. (5) Tail: run a curved tail from 53740 (276,281) down to the bow knot 54682 at about (220,375), then a long, slightly wavy trailing line to 51718 at (398,395), with two or three short ribbon strokes near the bow. (6) Keep the figure upright with the tail hanging down. Move the labels off the strokes, shorten them, and keep the title visible. Use the blue silhouette as the actual shape, not as a copy of the gold lines."]
